exposure: birth weight in relation to gestational age
cohort: All 2,421,284 children from singleton births in Sweden from 1973 to 1996
finding: Several perinatal risk factors, including smoking during pregnancy, breech presentation, cesarean delivery, preterm birth, and low Apgar scores, were associated with an increased risk of OCD, independent of shared familial factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of OCD (HR 1.17, 95% CI 1.01-1.34).
followup_time: Mean age at OCD diagnosis was 23.4 years
